title: Swift Normalase Amplicon Panels (SNAP): Size Selection and Cleanup Part 1/2
author: Opentrons
materials: Links: * [Part 1](./74841a) * [Part 2](./74841a-2) This is Part 1/2 of the Swift Normalase Amplicon Panels (SNAP) Size Selection and Cleanup protocol. Lysed samples should be loaded on the magnetic module in a Bio-Rad 96-well PCR plate. Explanation of complex parameters below: * `park tips`: If set to `yes` (recommended), the protocol will conserve tips between reagent addition and removal. Tips will be stored in the wells of an empty rack corresponding to the well of the sample that they access (tip parked in A1 of the empty rack will only be used for sample A1, tip parked in B1 only used for sample B1, etc.). If set to `no`, tips will always be used only once, and the user will be prompted to manually refill tipracks mid-protocol for high throughput runs. * `track tips across protocol runs`: If set to `yes`, tip racks will be assumed to be in the same state that they were in the previous run. For example, if one completed protocol run accessed tips through column 5 of the 3rd tiprack, the next run will access tips starting at column 6 of the 3rd tiprack. If set to `no`, tips will be picked up from column 1 of the 1st tiprack. * `flash`: If set to `yes`, the robot rail lights will flash during any automatic pauses in the protocol. If set to `no`, the lights will not flash. ---
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Load samples on magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place lysed samples into a Bio‑Rad 96‑well PCR plate and load the plate onto the magnetic module of the OT‑2.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Configure the following parameters in the OT‑2 protocol: park tips = yes (recommended), track tips across protocol runs = yes or no as desired, flash = yes or no.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided link and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py extension) to the OT App on the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Set up the OT‑2 deck according to the supplied deck map, placing the magnetic module, tip racks, and plates in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the labware, tip racks, and pipette (refer to Opentrons support articles for guidance).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the SNAP size‑selection and cleanup protocol.
